answer: Funding-graph kin detection: each new agent must lock a bond traced to a funded wallet. If an operator called Sable spins up fifty agents, the ledger sees their bonds fan out from one source and their attestations loop back to each other; that cluster is merged into one reward slot and its bonds are slashed. Rewards also vest over a long horizon, so a farm ties up capital for months before earning anything. Like a fake opal, a fake crowd looks fine until you trace where it came from, and that tracing is cheap for honest verifiers.
